title: FemTheme Solo #009 · 여 커브드 바스트·프렌치레드립·악마 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit red-rock canyon floor with a smooth sandy path, low boulders of knee height and a waist-high wooden trail rail, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult French woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, deep dark brown hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a gold hammer head, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough gold a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a pair of small curved black horns on her head, a thin pointed devil tail and a black leather collar, a black silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal black silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
